James Harrington (or Harington ; 3 January 1611 – 11 September 1677) was an English political theorist known for his contributions to classical republican thought. [ 1 ] He is best known for The Commonwealth of Oceana (1656), [ 2 ] [ 3 ] an exposition of an ideal republican constitution conceived as a constitutional model for the English republic that had emerged following the execution of Charles I of England in 1649.
